pricing_text: Billing is calculated per 1,000 video tokens. At **480p, 720p and 1080p**, the rate is **$0.014 without video references** or **$0.0086016 with video references**. At **4K**, the corresponding rates are approximately **$0.008** and **$0.0048**. With video references, the reduced rate applies to the combined input and output video token usage; image references alone do not trigger this reduction. Provider-reported usage is used when available; otherwise, usage is estimated from resolution and combined video duration, subject to minimum usage rules. For example, **100,000 provider-reported tokens at 720p** cost **$1.40 without video references** or approximately **$0.8602 with video references**. | Pricing section: Billed per second of generated 720p output: Standard, no video input $0.3024 / sec (10-sec clip ~$3.02); Standard, with video input $0.1814 / sec (0.6× discount) (~$1.81); Token-based billing $0.014 / 1,000 tokens. tokens = (height × width × (input_duration + output_duration) × 24) / 1024. Audio generation is included at no extra cost regardless of the generate_audio setting.
notes: الفوترة بالتوكنات ($0.014/1000 توكن عند 480p/720p/1080p؛ ≈$0.008 عند 4K). الرقم الحرفي الوحيد لكل ثانية في الصفحة هو 720p بدون مراجع فيديو = $0.3024/ث (الدقة الافتراضية). بتطبيق معادلة التوكنات من النص على 16:9: 480p (864×496) ≈ $0.1406/ث، 1080p (1920×1080) ≈ $0.6804/ث، 4K (3840×2160) ≈ $1.555/ث — محسوبة لا حرفية. مع مراجع فيديو: السعر 0.6× لكن يُحسب على توكنات المدخلات + المخرجات معًا. الصوت مضمّن.
